title: AeroBlade: Wind-Turbine Blade Aerodynamic Analysis, Design, Optimization, and CAD Export
description:
AeroBlade 2.1.3 is a portable Windows application for preliminary steady horizontal-axis wind-turbine aerodynamic analysis, blade design, optimization, power and energy estimation, and aerodynamic CAD export.

The release includes the compiled Windows x64 application, a User Guide, a Verification and Validation Report, checksums, a release manifest, license terms, and third-party notices. The source code is not included.

AeroBlade is intended for non-commercial research and teaching within the documented validation envelope. It is not a certification, structural, fatigue, aeroelastic, controller, acoustic, or safety-design tool.
